verdict.justification: Deliverable B is a more comprehensive and professional operational planning workbook that incorporates all nuances from the reference documents. Specifically, Deliverable B incorporates the 2% raw waste and 2% finished waste/shrinkage rates specified in the Product Specification document into its yield, batch requirement, and raw beef purchasing calculations, whereas Deliverable A completely omits the waste/shrinkage rates from its capacity model. Furthermore, Deliverable B structures its 'Production Assignment' tab to list all 20 individual personnel slots (which it counts via `COUNTA('Production Assignment'!C6:C25)`), aligning better with the prompt's request for the 20 personnel's allocation. Deliverable B also avoids artificial system meta-commentary that Deliverable A includes in its assumptions section (`No workspace operations records, registry or attachments were supplied...`). Finally, Deliverable B's daily run schedule (28 days) is much more intuitive for management review than Deliverable A's 70-row cycle-by-cycle log on the summary tab.
